mon/554f7348-ecc3-45cb-888d-9a8afe61b9bf.text: Authors whose books trained an AI are being paid in instalments, and the last one waits on the AI company's own stock market debut. The writers now have a quiet stake in the IPO of the firm they sued.
mon/554f7348-ecc3-45cb-888d-9a8afe61b9bf.rests_on: the final payment of about $450 million is due within about 30 days of Anthropic's IPO or a significant investment, and no later than September 2027

mon/554f7348-ecc3-45cb-888d-9a8afe61b9bf.text: A settlement about copying work without checking it came with its own correction notice: tens of thousands of claims had to be fixed first.
mon/554f7348-ecc3-45cb-888d-9a8afe61b9bf.rests_on: "tens of thousands of claims have been corrected"

mon/f5721a93-5b59-4d86-b53e-24bc70510d84.text: The companies a label once fought over AI music are now in its revenue plan, listed by name as growth.
mon/f5721a93-5b59-4d86-b53e-24bc70510d84.rests_on: naming Suno, Stability AI, KLAY and Udio

mon/f5721a93-5b59-4d86-b53e-24bc70510d84.text: Warner will take money from AI music firms while making sure fully AI songs are kept out of the royalty pot. The machines can pay in, they just cannot be paid out.
mon/f5721a93-5b59-4d86-b53e-24bc70510d84.rests_on: Warner has expanded deals requiring fully gen-AI content to be identified and removed from pro rata royalty shares

mon/013ae567-6e91-4c57-9128-9ce85eef667c.text: ITV's free AI ad maker worked so well as a gateway that almost a third of its users went off and hired ITV's human creative team instead.
mon/013ae567-6e91-4c57-9128-9ce85eef667c.rests_on: five of the 16 later moved to ITV's in-house creative team with bigger TV budgets

mon/80baed3f-3833-4bce-9afd-040a4868e562.text: An AI music company did not just skip paying for music licences; its website hands customers a ready-made letter to cancel theirs.
mon/80baed3f-3833-4bce-9afd-040a4868e562.rests_on: YourNeuroTune's website offers customers a template to cancel existing BumaStemra licences

mon/80baed3f-3833-4bce-9afd-040a4868e562.text: The rights body's whole legal argument fits on a fridge magnet.
mon/80baed3f-3833-4bce-9afd-040a4868e562.rests_on: "If you make money from music, you pay the creators."

wed/cf6e7746-6ce2-4c68-904a-d1ae1988bef9.text: Suno's new Ableton helper is generous with its uploads: open a session and your whole project, audio and all, goes to your Suno account.
wed/cf6e7746-6ce2-4c68-904a-d1ae1988bef9.rests_on: when a session is opened, Bridge uploads the Ableton project and its audio files to the user's Suno account

wed/cf6e7746-6ce2-4c68-904a-d1ae1988bef9.text: At 10 credits a generation, the $30 plan buys about a thousand tries at the stem you wanted.
wed/cf6e7746-6ce2-4c68-904a-d1ae1988bef9.rests_on: each generation costs 10 Suno credits; Premier costs $30 a month with 10,000 credits

wed/972b7721-4e4e-477f-b5cf-20164fd8260c.text: An AI music company built a video tool and then had to add filters so people could not use it to make videos of the artists and works it is often accused of borrowing from.
wed/972b7721-4e4e-477f-b5cf-20164fd8260c.rests_on: Suno added filters to block prompts that depict specific artists, public figures or copyrighted works

wed/08442c41-534a-4523-9818-0884e2fc985a.text: To prove a face online is really yours, you first prove to a third party that your face is really yours.
wed/08442c41-534a-4523-9818-0884e2fc985a.rests_on: "sign up by verifying their ID with a trusted third-party partner"

wed/08442c41-534a-4523-9818-0884e2fc985a.text: TikTok has labelled about five billion AI uploads, which is more than half the people on Earth, one each.
wed/08442c41-534a-4523-9818-0884e2fc985a.rests_on: TikTok says it has labelled about five billion AI uploads

wed/8c6c717d-00b4-4d26-b837-06b89709220a.text: A musician appealed twice through YouTube's own system and lost both times; one email from a journalist fixed it in about a day.
wed/8c6c717d-00b4-4d26-b837-06b89709220a.rests_on: YouTube restored it about 24 hours after 404 Media contacted Media Nov

fri/16b1fd4f-3785-4842-9a2b-19ccfe889fa8.text: At Ubisoft, reportedly, the thing you have to justify in a game pitch is doing it without the AI.
fri/16b1fd4f-3785-4842-9a2b-19ccfe889fa8.rests_on: "If you planned on not using it, you would have to have a reason"

fri/16b1fd4f-3785-4842-9a2b-19ccfe889fa8.text: The official line is encouragement, not a mandate, which is a fine distinction once a pitch needs a reason for saying no.
fri/16b1fd4f-3785-4842-9a2b-19ccfe889fa8.rests_on: Ubisoft says it encourages developers to use generative AI rather than mandate it

fri/5d55e729-43fd-433b-b4e5-056f5329cb05.text: In one year designers went from about half using AI weekly to nine in ten; the holdouts could now fit round a small dinner table in most studios.
fri/5d55e729-43fd-433b-b4e5-056f5329cb05.rests_on: 91% of designers use AI at least weekly, up from 54% a year earlier

fri/a4b34048-ab39-49da-a251-eaa58ebe2eaf.text: The first AI animated feature in cinemas needed a co-writer, editors, colourists, a Foley artist, a sound team and a cast of voice actors. The credits roll looks very human.
fri/a4b34048-ab39-49da-a251-eaa58ebe2eaf.rests_on: a "hybrid pipeline" with a co-writer, traditional post-production editors and colourists, a Foley artist, a sound team and a "dedicated ensemble of professional voice actors"

fri/a4b34048-ab39-49da-a251-eaa58ebe2eaf.text: The AI film still sent its sound team to a Stockholm studio for four days, because some things you still mix in a room.
fri/a4b34048-ab39-49da-a251-eaa58ebe2eaf.rests_on: the sound team spent four days in a Stockholm studio on the theatrical mix

fri/ac13c2b0-5426-4018-aaeb-eed82b9d0a6c.text: The AI music awards were judged by AI artists, which makes it the rare awards show where the voters and the nominees share a category.
fri/ac13c2b0-5426-4018-aaeb-eed82b9d0a6c.rests_on: winners were picked by AI artists who are members of the Sonic Intelligence Academy

fri/ac13c2b0-5426-4018-aaeb-eed82b9d0a6c.text: AI artist of the year was an avatar whose lyrics were all written by a person.
fri/ac13c2b0-5426-4018-aaeb-eed82b9d0a6c.rests_on: Jones said she wrote all of the lyrics and then set them to music with the help of AI

tue/photonstems.text: Software that pulls up to six voices out of one recording is the first tool that can finally tell you who was singing flat in the group take.
tue/photonstems.rests_on: up to six voices out of one recording

tue/splicecreate.text: Splice's new app is free to make music in. Letting anyone else hear it is the part with the monthly fee.
tue/splicecreate.rests_on: Making is free; exporting and licensing need the $9.99-a-month plan.

tue/djvoices.text: Spotify gave its AI DJ nine new voices and, in the same update, a setting to make it stop talking.
tue/djvoices.rests_on: Spotify's AI DJ now has nine new voices and a setting that cuts most of the talking between songs.

tue/freeanimation.text: Motion capture used to mean a suit covered in ping-pong balls; now a webcam does a fair bit of it for nothing.

tue/grimesdeepseek.text: An album about AI made without AI, except for the one song named after an AI, which an AI helped write.
tue/grimesdeepseek.rests_on: she used no generative AI on it, apart from one song, "DeepSeek", whose lyrics were partly written by DeepSeek

thu/elevensoundcloud.text: Three free months of AI songwriting, then a renewal date that arrives with the confidence of a gym membership.
thu/elevensoundcloud.rests_on: SoundCloud Artist Pro members get three months of ElevenMusic Pro free. After that it is $9.99 a month

thu/videoplugin.text: Your chatbot can now bring a plus-one: a video tool that sits at the table and does exactly one job.
thu/videoplugin.rests_on: A connector lets your chatbot call another app for you, like a guest at the table who does one job.

thu/hackertube.text: One of the best-known people in AI got so fed up with an algorithm that he had an AI build him a site run on what humans recommend instead.
thu/hackertube.rests_on: Fed up with his YouTube recommendations, Andrej Karpathy had an AI build him a video site in about two hours: 6,454 videos picked from 43 million comments where real people recommended them.

thu/hackertube.text: It took 43 million comments to find 6,454 videos worth watching, which says something about the comments.

thu/klingthirty.text: You can feed it up to 15 reference images to get one 30-second clip, roughly one picture for every two seconds of film.
thu/klingthirty.rests_on: Kling 4.0 makes single AI video clips up to 30 seconds long from up to 15 of your own reference images or clips.

thu/threecuts.text: Creators who used to argue with themselves about which opening was better can now let three versions argue it out in public.
thu/threecuts.rests_on: YouTube lets creators test up to three different cuts of a video to see which opening holds viewers best

sat/goodnews.text: The best-mannered man in New York this week is animated, and one of the people he helps is the pizza rat.
sat/goodnews.rests_on: follows an animated gentleman helping pedestrians, buskers and the pizza rat

sat/goodnews.text: Someone built a game painted with about 1.5 million brush strokes in every single frame, a workload no studio of human painters would sign up for.
sat/goodnews.rests_on: a game painted with about 1.5 million brush strokes a frame

sat/arenanight.text: A basketball arena now has an official AI assistant partner, a job title that did not exist when most of its fans first bought a season ticket.
sat/arenanight.rests_on: Google Gemini is now the official AI assistant partner of the Golden State Warriors
